paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of and by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: This chart illustrates the "effect" values associated with different language families, as measured by two models, mBERT and XLM, and their permuted versions. The horizontal axis categorizes data by language family, with labels including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick labels incrementing by 10. Six bars are presented for each language family. Two bars represent the mBERT model, colored dark blue, and the XLM model, colored light blue. An additional two bars, representing permuted versions of mBERT and XLM, are displayed in green and gray respectively; these bars are accompanied by error bars indicating the data's standard deviation. The shortest bars, representing the Uralic language family, have an approximate length of 1, while the tallest bars representing the IE-Germanic language family exhibit an approximate length of 31. The bars are sorted by language family in a potentially linguistic or alphabetical order. No bars are visually emphasized, and no grouping or stacking of data are utilized within each bar.
